note: 2025 Panini Rookies & Stars Football, base and insert sections. The autograph subsets are NOT here: under R30 (Drew 2026-09-13) each same-numbered autograph subset is its own card set and carries its own setKey (panini-rookies-and-stars-<subset>). Splitting them out is what removes the 1,296 duplicate slugs -- 41 of them merging different players -- that this product produced when all 25 subsets shared one key and one blank parallel. isAuto comes from the section name by word boundary: the Insider workbooks publish no Auto column, and an unanchored /auto/ would read 'Airborne Pink' as an autograph on the 'ink' substring.
